element_chart.target_override_precedence: explicit weakness or resistance overrides the cycle; a target cannot list the same element as both

damage.formula: max(1, floor(effective_attack * skill_multiplier * (10 / (10 + max(0, effective_target_defense))) * element_multiplier * product(status_and_other_multipliers) * critical_multiplier))
damage.target_defense_resolution: Choose defender.def for physical damage; choose defender.res for magic/elemental damage; if res is absent, use defender.def.

stat_resolution.growth_scale_note: growth_per_level is a small flat increment, authored from a modest percentage of the level-one stat; HP/ATK/DEF/SPD stay in a compact low-integer display scale.
stat_resolution.res_stat_fallback: when explicit res is absent, use effective def; RES buffs/debuffs resolve against the same fallback

status_timing.control_duration_rounding: minimum one turn when base duration is positive
status_timing.dot_tick: owner turn start after duration decrement and before passive hooks/action
status_timing.same_status_refresh: higher remaining duration replaces; never stack identical status_id
status_timing.status_applied_by_turn_start_hook: is active for the current action and expires at the next owner-turn decrement

targeting.area_targeting: target selector is authored per effect operation
targeting.enemy_taunt: after target selection, redirect eligible single-target hostile actions to a living taunter; area actions are never redirected
targeting.front_row_protection: single-target attacks select living Front heroes first unless selector explicitly ignores row

turn_queue.cycle_definition: At cycle start snapshot living combatants. A cycle closes when every snapshot member has acted once or died; faster units may act again before closure. Spawned units join at the next cycle.
turn_queue.new_wave_gauge: living units keep current gauge; newly spawned wave enemies start at zero gauge

skills.description_en: Deals physical damage equal to 100% of ATK to one enemy. If Mahmut is in the Front Row, he gains Stoneguard, reducing damage taken by 8% for 1 turn.

Low-tier bell-wired remains; individually weak, dangerous in numbers.

A support cultist who links allies and shares a portion of their wounds.

A slow, stubborn frontliner with high HP and a crushing step.
A paper-wrapped corpse that marks targets with debuff ink.
An elite dead knight who punishes shields and exposed Front units.
An attendant's ghost intercepts the next single-target strike for its most-injured ally.
A bloated orchard dead that gains defense while feeding.
A back-row bomber whose flask racks can be interrupted.
A quick courier with a poison dart and a route-marking shot.
A heavily armoured royal remnant that blocks one attack per round.

record.story_beat_en: Mahmut and Fadyme defeat Ash Wolves; Fadyme recognizes the bell pattern but calls it an echo.

Brin is rescued while defending a collapsed wayshrine; Nixie and Kera help the two starters field a five-person story-loan team. Brin joins permanently and the shrine keeper grants a First Oath Invitation for one permanent 4-star hero.
Kera loses an alchemy cart to Hollow Pilgrims and trades a vial for a route map.
Nixie joins the company after scouting the safe route; she and Brin complete the guaranteed five-hero story roster before the first boss.
A wolf carcass fused with a cracked bell attacks in two phases; Fadyme's fingertips lose color after victory.
Hollow Clerics occupy the nave; a bell rings with no clapper.
Aveline evacuates pilgrims and lends her healing kit against paired Choir Knights.
Mirel finds Fadyme's name scraped from the royal guest register.
A prayer ledger and royal page describe a life held against the dark; Fadyme closes the book.
Yseldra guards the record chamber; after defeat she refuses execution and escapes through the bell tower, leaving the seven-notched seal. Nixie leaves to warn Oakhaven.
Nixie returns with a warning that mercenaries are collecting people with royal marks.
Jori barricades the forge; Kera identifies red glass on the enemy weapons.
Fadyme coughs blood after a spell and wipes it from Mahmut's glove; defend villagers from poisoners.
Pippa calms villagers with a song and carries their names to a refuge; Jori joins the party.
Captain Rusk falls and drops an order addressed to the Undercity Red Vial Guild. The reverse bears the seven-notched seal and initials C.V.
The party descends into the Undercity and follows Odelia's trail through Glass Vipers.
Kera brings a guild ledger to a hidden healing ward run by Tilda and Iona.
Clem leads Fadyme to a private alchemist, who says the bell has accelerated the curse: she has weeks, perhaps less. Fadyme asks him to keep it from Mahmut.
Fadyme claims a restorative elixir may help while Kera tests an incomplete recipe.
The Matron is defeated; Kera stays to copy the antidote archive while Tilda and Iona reopen the ward.
Marek recognizes Mahmut's stripped crest and helps refugees cross the bridge.
Nara holds the bridge gate while the party disables two siege winches.
Sable and Rikka infiltrate a supply tower and find Mahmut's commander's seal on a hunt order.
A bell pulse turns one lock of Fadyme's hair white; she hides it beneath her hood.
Marshal Oren admits the Crown Guard knew Fadyme's blood was tied to the rite; companions split to protect refugees and follow the estate road.
Sable opens the locked servant wing while Clem finds names scratched from its door list.
The party searches the portrait gallery while Hana protects the archivists.
Vespera recognizes the Undercity ward pattern; healers prepare a field infirmary.
The manor collapses after the ledger page is recovered; Fadyme uses a forbidden burst to hold an arch. Mirel finds the same seal beside a handless-watch diagram signed C.V.
The Wraith falls; Mirel confirms the ledger is a schedule pointing to the First Eclipse Altar.
Scouts chart the altar approach and Jori recognizes smith marks on its chains.
Companions return with survivors and hold the outer steps while the core team advances.
The companions reconstruct the missing record; Fadyme's erased name is written back by hand.
The full cast prepares barriers and evacuation routes; Fadyme asks Mahmut to remain beside her after the battle.

record.story_beat_en: The Construct falls silent and Fadyme collapses. In a separate VN scene she tells Mahmut the curse is killing her; after their confession, a second scene reveals Lord Cael Veyr, the presumed-dead Clockless Chancellor, and his offer to return her time at a price.
